description: This file contains custom Cypress commands used for testing a dashboard application, including setting up API mocks, login procedures, and seed data.

methods.name: mockApi
methods.description: Sets up intercepts for various API endpoints to mock backend responses for login, user management, reports, and charts for testing purposes.

methods.name: loginUI
methods.description: Automates the login UI process for tests by filling out login form and submitting it.

methods.name: seedAuth
methods.description: Seeds authentication token directly into local storage to bypass login UI for testing authenticated states.
